_meta.subject: Mechanization capability for the plugins workspace — 'if it can (or should) be mechanized, mechanize it as scripts/taskname.py|js'
prior_art: check-all-skills/check-all-agents standard-of-excellence A4 'Mechanization' — scores the property but is an audit rubric, not an authoring standard
skill-writing-rules degrees-of-freedom row — 'a bundled script beats instructions to improvise one' (doctrine, no anatomy)
workspace CLAUDE.md invariants — 'incident → infrastructure, same day' + 'every scripts/*.py carries a selftest mode'
~40 scripts across 9 plugins implementing the convention implicitly (naming, exit codes, selftest, stdlib-only)

nodes.label: standard body: script anatomy (argv contract, exit codes, selftest mode, stdlib-only, ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} pathing), placement rule (skill-level vs plugin-level scripts/), language rule (py default, mjs for node-domain checks), the can-vs-should judgment boundary ('arithmetic, not judgment'), gate-discovery facts
references/selftest-patterns.md — worked selftest + negative-control shapes (inversion fixtures, reverse controls, fact-x-fact consistency gates)
Phase: qualify — detector signals (repeated manual step, prose checklist, eyeballed gate) + the escape hatch for judgment-work
Phase: plan — script name, language, home, selftest shape, caller wiring
Phase: confirm — AskUserQuestion gate carrying the concrete plan
Phase: author — write scripts/taskname.py|mjs to the standard
Phase: validate — selftest green, negative control bites, wired into caller prose + release_gate sweep
make-script evals/evals.json + routing corpus (trigger + fence cases)
reciprocal fence cases in neighbor suites: make-hook (event-fired enforcement), save-lessons (prose knowledge), make-skill (whole new skill)
canon repoint: check-all-skills / check-all-agents A4 sections cite script-writing-rules as the canon for the mechanization bar
G4 parity: release_gate's selftest sweep extended to scripts/*.mjs|*.js (node-guarded), with a selftest fixture proving the new leg bites

actions.label: spot a mechanization candidate mid-work (a check being eyeballed, a procedure restated in prose, a manual step repeated)
decide can-vs-should and refuse judgment-work (state 'the checker can never see X' explicitly)
assemble a concrete plan: taskname, py|mjs, skill-level vs plugin-level home, selftest shape
confirm with the user before any file is written
author the script to the standard (argv, exit codes, pathing, stdlib-only)
prove the selftest green AND the negative control bites (a wrong input is caught, a right input is not flagged)
wire the script into its caller — the owning SKILL.md invokes it by path; gate discovery picks it up
answer 'how should a bundled script look / where does it live / py or js' asks from one canon
teach selftest and negative-control anatomy by worked example
route mechanization asks correctly and repel the three near-neighbors bidirectionally
keep one canon: the audits' A4 dimension cites the standard instead of restating it
ground the gate facts before publishing them: verify what release_gate's selftest sweep actually discovers (py? mjs? per-skill vs plugin-level?) and record verified behavior only
prove js-side scripts at the gate too — G4 today rglobs only scripts/*.py, so every .mjs check in the estate ships with its selftest never run (grounded 2026-07-14, release_gate.py:99)

edges.why: the standard records gate-discovery behavior — close the G4 js hole first so the standard records the fixed state, not the hole
the author phase writes TO the standard — the standard's anatomy must exist before the workflow that cites it
the canon repoint needs the canon to exist
reciprocal fences answer make-script's own suite — its trigger phrases must be fixed before siblings fence them
